name: Moonlit Sapphire Lake
description: A serene lake of deep sapphire water reflecting the silvery moon, surrounded by crystal‑clear mist and floating moon‑petals.
prompt: Calm sapphire lake at night, moon’s silver light shimmering across water, surrounding cliffs edged with glowing moon‑petals, soft mist drifting, dreamy nocturnal atmosphere.
caption: Mirror of the night sky—Sapphire waters hold the moon’s secret. 🌙💎
